title: Release artifact validation intermittently fails on native binary check (better-sqlite3 test_extension.node)
description:
The Release workflow's "Build artifact" job intermittently fails release
artifact validation on macOS and Windows runners with:

    Error: forbidden content (unexpected native binary): app/node_modules/@eshyra/core/node_modules/better-sqlite3/build/Release/test_extension.node

Source: scripts/release/validate-release-artifact.mjs FORBIDDEN_ANYWHERE rule
(around line 95) only allowlists `better_sqlite3.node` and rejects any other
`.node` file found anywhere in the packed artifact, including vendored deps.

better-sqlite3 apparently produces (or its native install step sometimes
triggers a local build that produces) a `test_extension.node` binary used for
its own extension-loading tests. On some macOS/Windows CI runs this ends up
in the packed `node_modules` tree and trips the validator; on other runs
(often an immediate rerun of the identical commit) it does not appear and the
job passes.

Confirmed to be a pre-existing platform/native-install flake, unrelated to
any specific dependency bump:
- Hit PR #550 (`@openai/codex-sdk` bump, does not touch better-sqlite3) on
  `claude/macos-14` — run 34860077302, job 104029650883. Passed clean on
  rerun of the same commit.
- Hit PR #548 (dev-tooling group: biome + @types/node, does not touch
  better-sqlite3) on `api/macos-14`, `api/windows-latest`, and
  `codex/macos-14` — run 34860035666, jobs 104029505720 / 104029505636 /
  (codex/macos-14). Passed clean on rerun of the same commit.
- Also seen previously on 2026-09-07 on an unrelated
  `dependabot/npm_and_yarn/model-provider-sdks-9b66f2d325` branch — run
  34169209961 — while sibling dependency PRs on the same day passed.

Because CI has no branch-protection required-checks gate on this repo
(`gh api repos/.../branches/main/protection` -> 404), this flake doesn't
currently block merges, but it burns CI minutes, requires manual reruns, and
erodes trust in the Release artifact validation signal. Per AGENTS.md's
native-dependency policy, an accidental source-build fallback for
better-sqlite3 is itself treated as a regression -- this may be exactly that,
manifesting as a leaked test-build artifact rather than a build failure.

Likely directions (root-cause first, no fix without evidence):
1. Determine why `test_extension.node` sometimes gets built/copied into the
   packed tree on macOS/Windows specifically -- e.g. prebuilt-binary download
   flakiness silently falling back to a local `node-gyp` build that also
   builds better-sqlite3's test extension as a side effect.
2. If the file is legitimately produced by a normal (non-fallback) native
   install step and is harmless test-only output, prune it from the packaged
   artifact during the release build step rather than loosening the
   validator's allowlist.
3. If it turns out to indicate an actual source-build fallback, treat per the
   existing native-dep regression policy (docs/adr/0008, docs/adr/0016).

Acceptance: root cause documented; a fix lands (packaging-side prune, and/or
native-install fix) so the artifact-validation failure stops reproducing
across several consecutive Release runs on macOS/Windows; no weakening of
scripts/release/validate-release-artifact.mjs's native-binary allowlist
without documented justification.
